dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Welcome to Liuli Pavilion! How many are there in your group? Do you have a reservation?

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Certainly! You may enjoy our classic Li cooking wherever you choose.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it always necessary to make a reservation?

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm terribly sorry for the inconvenience. If you wish to eat inside the restaurant, we ask that you make a reservation three months in advance. I will be sure to make a record of it.

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Oh? You think it's a long time to wait? At the Liuli Pavilion, we can only seat a few guests at certain times each day, hence the three month wait.

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Besides, for a chance to eat in Li cuisine paradise, surely three months is not too long...?

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: People that come to Liuli Pavilion do so because they love eating the treasures of the mountains cooked in classic Li style. Everyone has to wait their turn, even the rich and famous.

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: You can get food to go if you want, but you'll be missing out on the atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Licai
dialogues.text: Take care. Let me know promptly if you ever want to make a reservation!
